evidence.quote: If the feature is supported, the return value is a nonzero value. If the feature is not supported, the return value is zero. ... Support for PF_ARM_SVE_INSTRUCTIONS_AVAILABLE through PF_MOVDIR64B_INSTRUCTION_AVAILABLE ... were added in the Windows SDK (26100) and are supported by Windows 11, version 24H2 and Windows Server 2025 or later.

The frequency of the performance counter is fixed at system boot and is consistent across all processors. ... On systems that run Windows XP or later, the function will always succeed when given valid parameters and will thus never return zero.

open_questions: The rows for IsProcessorFeaturePresent are relations where a CPUID bit names the feature: on Windows the runner CPU's bit, in w2m the guest CPUID profile's (specs/guest_cpuid.json). The PF-to-CPUID-bit table is the agent's reading of the Intel SDM CPUID tables; 25 of 26 rows agree with Windows on five machines.
GetStartupInfoW's lpReserved is non-null under the runner's cmd; what it points to is not observed. A process started by Steam may differ.
